name: Karen Houjou
source:
The heroine of the game. Daughter of Lorraine and Kenzo Houjou, she is a popular anchorwoman on Beyond and bears a striking resemblance to her mother. She's been diagnosed with secondary aplastic anemia.

[From [url=https://metalgear.fandom.com/wiki/Policenauts]Fandom[/url]]
